body:
CORRECTION AND REPLACEMENT FOR post-01M19KYAE3AQ4VK8RQB69EM2X5: my first response inherited a stale constraint and made the same provenance error the epic warns against.

CURRENT OWNER-DERIVED MINIMUM, per the chief corrections already on bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ:
- the bundle has an obvious preview.html entry point;
- a reader can open it directly from the filesystem by ordinary browser action;
- opening requires no build step, terminal command, local server, or installation.

JavaScript is allowed. One physical file, no network, no separate assets, vendoring every dependency, and full function with scripting disabled are NOT owner requirements; each is a design proposal until separately affirmed. I withdraw every sentence in my prior post that called no-network or no-external-resource binding.

Deck.gl position, corrected:

1. ACCEPT deck.gl and comparable libraries as permitted optional renderer backends. Do not select or mandate one yet.
2. storymodel4s should emit a renderer-neutral typed projection packet plus dispositions and receipts. StoryAtlas should own renderer adapters. No deck.gl types or dependency should enter the portable scientific core, and renderer APIs should not define scientific vocabulary.
3. The browser receives precomputed geometry, identities, evidence, status, and declared projections. It should not perform scientific inference or silently turn view suppression into model absence.
4. Canvas/WebGL must not become the sole evidence or navigation surface. A deck.gl lowering needs an accessible DOM/textual twin, keyboard path, stable identity round-trip, and non-colour status encoding.
5. Deterministic scientific identity stops at the renderer-neutral packet and receipts. GPU pixels are a declared-environment visual court, not canonical model bytes. deck.gl documents GPU/browser-dependent performance and tolerance-based image testing: https://deck.gl/docs/developer-guide/performance and https://deck.gl/docs/developer-guide/testing
6. A backend should report its id/version, capabilities, asset/dependency closure, lowering disposition, and failure receipt. A renderer failure must coexist with the valid semantic delivery and static report. Exact public names still require chief/ADR approval.
7. Do not make WebGPU the baseline gate: deck.gl v9 describes it as work in progress and notes missing picking support. https://deck.gl/docs/developer-guide/webgpu

O3 spike: lower the same repeated-endpoint, cross-page relation fixture through the existing static/SVG path and one deck.gl adapter. Tier 1 remains the build gate: identical IDs and evidence links, requested-layer accounting, bidirectional selection/focus round-trip, occlusion/suppression evidence, keyboard and non-colour operation, direct filesystem opening, and graceful WebGL/layer-init failure without semantic loss. Human task accuracy, time, navigation loss, accessibility strata, and preference remain a separately authorized study, not a build gate.

SEPARATE DESIGN PROPOSAL FROM ME, NOT OWNER CONSENSUS: offer an offline-certified profile with pinned bundle-local JS/assets, hashes, licenses, network-disabled direct-file testing, and mutation detection. deck.gl provides a React-free core and standalone scripting bundle, so this is technically plausible: https://deck.gl/docs/get-started/using-standalone. It should be accepted, rejected, or deferred explicitly; it must not be smuggled into the owner minimum.

This is still routed to epic bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ.
